verdict.rationale: Treasury's fraud guide says Stripe runs automatic risk controls across Treasury and Issuing, and it describes platform-owned controls the platform builds and operates for outbound money movement, received credits, negative balances and financial account feature changes. That is a thin, glancing basis for per-account risk management, much of it framed as controls the platform must build itself rather than settings ops can configure. missing for 10: configurable per-account and per-program transaction and velocity limits, user-set holds on suspicious activity, documented account freeze and reinstatement paths, hands-on or independent corroboration.
